sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能预见到任何可以想象的结局吗？

sentences.en: I mean, is there any conceivable endgame that you can see?
sentences.zh: 因为，我的意思是，这对普京来说显然已经变得非常糟糕了。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, it's obviously gone terribly wrong for Putin.
sentences.zh: 战争进展不顺，非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The war's gone wrong, gone badly.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 经济受到的打击比他预期的要严重得多。

sentences.en: The economy has been hit much worse than he'd anticipated.
sentences.zh: 没有……

sentences.en: There's no...
sentences.zh: 他唯一能真正退缩的方式就是说，我搞错了。

sentences.en: The only way that he can really row back is to kind of say, I got it wrong.
sentences.zh: 但他永远不会那样做。

sentences.en: And he's never going to do that.
sentences.zh: 他不会那样做的，不。

sentences.en: He's not going to do that, no.
sentences.zh: 所以，唯一的选择似乎就是升级战争，不是吗？

sentences.en: So, the only option really seems to be to escalate it, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 试图与北约发生某种冲突。

sentences.en: And to try and get in a kind of fight with NATO.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一种非常、非常严峻的说法。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a very, very grim way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 我想他……

sentences.en: I think he...
sentences.zh: 所以，我的解读是这样的。

sentences.en: So, my reading of it is this.
sentences.zh: 普京像许多人一样，最终相信了自己的宣传，只是被那些只说他想听的话的人包围着。

sentences.en: That Putin, like so many people, ended up believing his own propaganda, just being surrounded by people who told him what he wanted to hear.
sentences.zh: 西方是软弱的。

sentences.en: That the West was weak.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰基本上是一团糟，是一个科学怪人式的国家。

sentences.en: That Ukraine was basically a complete shambles and a Frankenstein's monster of a country.
sentences.zh: 你觉得他真的认为他们是一群纳粹吗？

sentences.en: And do you think he really thought that they were a bunch of Nazis?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他竟然对一个由犹太总统领导的国家说这种话。

sentences.en: I mean, he's literally saying about a state led by a Jewish president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's crazy.
sentences.zh: 我想他有一部分是这样。

sentences.en: I think there's a bit of him.
sentences.zh: 这很难说，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's impossible to say, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 希特勒相信他所说的那些疯狂的事情吗？

sentences.en: Did Hitler believe all the mad things that Hitler...
sentences.zh: 是的，我想他相信，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I think he did, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 我想他是相信的。

sentences.en: I suppose he did.
sentences.zh: 斯大林呢？

sentences.en: Did Stalin?
sentences.zh: 斯大林呢？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You end up believing it yourself, don't you?
sentences.zh: 你最终连自己都信了，不是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this is the thing with politicians.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是政客们的问题所在。

sentences.en: You end up...
sentences.zh: 你最终会……

sentences.en: Part of you knows that some of it is contrived, exaggerated, all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 你心里清楚其中一些是虚构的、夸大的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But you end up convincing yourself, especially if you're in an echo chamber where other people just articulate your prejudices to you.
sentences.zh: 但你最终还是会说服自己，尤其是当你身处回声室中，周围的人都在不断强化你的偏见时。

sentences.en: Or is it an illustration of my thesis that Hitler has become the devil?
sentences.zh: 还是说，这恰恰印证了我的论点，即希特勒已经成了恶魔的代名词？

sentences.en: And that your enemies, if you're in a kind of Manichaean, good and evil, light and dark, your enemies have to be Nazis because that's the only possible justification.
sentences.zh: 如果你陷入那种摩尼教式的善恶、光明与黑暗的二元对立，那么你的敌人就必须是纳粹，因为这是唯一可能的正当理由。

sentences.en: That's absolutely true in Russia because what's happened in Russia in the last 20 years is the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯这绝对是真的，因为过去20年里在俄罗斯发生的一切，就是第二次世界大战的重演。

sentences.en: I mean, God, think how much we beat ourselves up in Britain about this.
sentences.zh: 天哪，想想我们在英国对此有多么纠结。

sentences.en: The Second World War has become a stifling kind of national myth, so everything is seen through that prism.
sentences.zh: 二战已经成为一种令人窒息的国家神话，所以一切都被置于那个棱镜下审视。

sentences.en: And in a way, yeah, they now, even if there's no evidence of Nazism whatsoever...
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，是的，他们现在，即使根本没有任何纳粹主义的证据……

sentences.en: I mean, by the way, there are far-right extremists in Ukraine, but they are such a minority on the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，乌克兰确实有极右翼极端分子，但他们在政治光谱中只是极少数。

sentences.en: They don't even hold, I think, any seats in the Ukrainian parliament.
sentences.zh: 我想他们甚至在乌克兰议会中没有任何席位。

sentences.en: No, and to repeat, their president is Jewish.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且再次重申，他们的总统是犹太人。

sentences.en: Their president is a Russian speaker and is Jewish.
sentences.zh: 他们的总统讲俄语，而且是犹太人。

sentences.en: Exactly, Tom.
sentences.zh: 正是如此，汤姆。

sentences.en: I mean, I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: And so part of the kind of the paradoxical horror of what's happening is that the Russians are,
sentences.zh: 所以，这件事荒谬而恐怖的一面在于，俄罗斯人……

sentences.en: they've become their worst nightmares.
sentences.zh: 他们已经变成了自己最可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: So they are, you know, they're making Stalingrad's out of Ukrainian cities in which they are playing the part of the Germans.
sentences.zh: 他们正在把乌克兰的城市变成斯大林格勒，而他们自己却扮演着当年德国人的角色。

sentences.en: They are indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And they're laying siege to Kiev as the Mongols laid siege to it.
sentences.zh: 他们正在围攻基辅，就像当年蒙古人围攻那里一样。

sentences.en: So they're playing the part of the Mongols.
sentences.zh: 所以他们扮演的是蒙古人的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah, agreed.
sentences.zh: 是的，同意。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个糟糕的局面。

sentences.en: Anyway, you asked about the endgame.
sentences.zh: 总之，你刚才问到了结局。

sentences.en: Sorry, Tom, I didn't, I rambled and didn't answer.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，汤姆，我刚才扯远了，没回答你的问题。

sentences.en: You asked about the endgame.
sentences.zh: 你问的是结局。

sentences.en: Piusan is now in a position where when he wakes up in the morning and thinks about his options, continuing fighting is probably his least worst option as he sees it.
sentences.zh: 普京现在的处境是，当他每天早上醒来思考自己的选择时，继续战斗对他来说可能是最不坏的选择。

sentences.en: He can't stop and say it was all a mistake.
sentences.zh: 他不能停下来承认这一切都是个错误。

sentences.en: He can't really declare victory and go home, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我认为他真的无法宣布胜利然后回家。

sentences.en: Um, there's almost no way back for him now with the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他现在几乎没有回头路可以走了，面对西方。

sentences.en: It's hard to see, you know, it's not like he can say, he can say, sorry, I've made a mistake and people will relax the sanctions.
sentences.zh: 很难想象，他不可能说“抱歉，我犯了个错”，然后人们就会放宽制裁。

sentences.en: I mean, that's not really how it works.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事情不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: I think he thinks I will just power through.
sentences.zh: 我想他认为自己会硬撑过去。

sentences.en: He perhaps thinks there'll be, if there's a change of administration in America, you know, if the West will lose interest, um, people get bored.
sentences.zh: 他可能认为，如果美国政府更迭，或者西方失去兴趣，人们感到厌倦了……

sentences.en: I'll present them with a fait accompli.
sentences.zh: 我会给他们造成既定事实。

sentences.en: I mean, he's no stranger to frozen conflicts as well.
sentences.zh: 而且，他对“冻结冲突”也并不陌生。

sentences.en: So Georgia, Transnistria, places like that, where basically the Russians are still there, but it's just sort of, there's just a stalemate in these places.
sentences.zh: 比如格鲁吉亚、德涅斯特河沿岸这些地方，基本上俄罗斯人还在那里，但只是陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: So perhaps he thinks I'll just keep fighting.
sentences.zh: 所以他可能认为，我会一直打下去。

sentences.en: It'll end up being a stalemate in Ukraine forever and ever.
sentences.zh: 最终乌克兰会陷入永无止境的僵局。

sentences.en: And eventually I'll get what I want because they'll lose interest and all this stuff.
sentences.zh: 最后我总能得到我想要的，因为他们会失去兴趣，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I mean, the problem he'll have is, is losses of troops, you know, and losses of money.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他将面临的问题是部队的损失，还有金钱的损失。

sentences.en: Expensive losses of money.
sentences.zh: 代价高昂的资金损失。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 是的，你说得对。

sentences.en: I mean, the trouble is a lot of young Russians have been connected, haven't they?
sentences.zh: 问题是，很多年轻的俄罗斯人都已经与世界网络接轨了，不是吗？

sentences.en: To the sort of world network.
sentences.zh: 与那种全球网络。

sentences.en: I mean, just even small things like they're not going to get Netflix.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是一些小事，比如他们没法看奈飞了。

sentences.en: They're not going to get the new cinema releases.
sentences.zh: 他们没法看新的电影上映了。

sentences.en: They're not going to get Apple products.
sentences.zh: 他们没法买苹果产品了。

sentences.en: They're not going to get all these things.
sentences.zh: 他们没法得到所有这些东西了。

sentences.en: And of course, these are all kind of middle-class things, but often the middle-class is the very people who drive revolutions and regime changes.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些都是中产阶级的东西，但往往正是中产阶级在推动革命和政权更迭。

sentences.en: Sorry, this is a very morbid end of the podcast, Tom.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，这期播客的结尾太沉重了，汤姆。

sentences.en: Well, it's a morbid subject, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这本身就是一个沉重的话题，不是吗？

sentences.en: It is a morbid subject.
sentences.zh: 确实是个沉重的话题。

sentences.en: It's hard not to feel depressed about it.
sentences.zh: 很难不为此感到沮丧。

sentences.en: So we should be back.
sentences.zh: 所以我们应该会回来的。

sentences.en: We should be back, hopefully, with more jolly material.
sentences.zh: 我们应该会回来，希望带着更愉快的内容。

sentences.en: Maybe Tom will do some impersonations next time to cheer us up.
sentences.zh: 也许下次汤姆会模仿一些人来让我们开心一下。

sentences.en: And on that note, we'll say thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 说到这里，我们要感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.zh: 感谢收听《历史的余韵》。
